newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia govt to pass tax code to Duma before Apr 30.
newsitem.headline: Russia govt to pass tax code to Duma before Apr 30.

text.p: The Russian government will submit a new draft tax code to the State Duma lower house of parliament not later than April 30, Tass news agency quoted Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin as saying on Friday.
The cabinet is considering on Friday the final draft of the second, third and fourth parts of the code.
The first part was submitted to the Duma last year.

The International Monetary Fund Managing Director Michel Camdessus has said submitting of the darft code to parliament was a pre-condition for the release of IMF's funds to back Russia's 1997 economic programme.
